properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 15 at 1:50AM CDT until September 15 at 2:00AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has moved out of the area.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, heavy
rain is still possible with this thunderstorm.

properties.areaDesc: Adair, IA; Audubon, IA; Cass, IA; Guthrie, IA
properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 15 at 1:43AM CDT until September 15 at 2:15AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
SVRDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northern Cass County in southwestern Iowa...
Southwestern Guthrie County in west central Iowa...
Southern Audubon County in west central Iowa...
Northwestern Adair County in southwestern Iowa...

* Until 215 AM CDT.

* At 143 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Brayton, or 8
miles northeast of Atlantic, moving east at 50 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Atlantic, Anita, Exira, Adair, Elk Horn, Kimballton, Brayton,
Marne, Wiota, Lake Anita State Park, Atlantic Municipal Airport,
and Anita Municipal Airport.

This includes Interstate 80 between mile markers 50 and 80.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 14 at 9:23PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Tampa Bay Ruskin has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From Wednesday morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Monday the stage was 9.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
Wednesday morning and continue rising to 12.4 feet Thursday
evening. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.5
feet on 08/31/2002.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Tuesday afternoon at 200 PM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT FROM WEDNESDAY MORNING UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 14 at 9:25PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Marion, Citrus and Levy
Counties.

.Elevated water levels are expected along the river over the next
several days due to recent heavy rainfall.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river
in Citrus and Marion counties.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 PM EDT Monday the stage was 28.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue rising to 28.2 feet just
after midnight tonight. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.4
feet on 08/05/2024.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Tuesday afternoon at 200 PM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE
